title: Butternut Squash, Caramelised Onion and Spinach Lasagne
changes_from_base: Puréed roast butternut squash, a rosemary ricotta layer topped with slowly browned red onions and a spinach and parmesan white sauce replace the meat ragù.
summary: Sweet roasted squash, sticky caramelised red onions and a creamy spinach sauce come together in a comforting layered bake.

ingredients.item: medium red onions, cut into thin strips
frozen chopped spinach, defrosted and squeezed dry
fresh lasagne sheets (6), or no-boil dried sheets
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C, halve the 1400 g squash lengthwise, scoop out the seeds, set it in the tin and drizzle with 45 ml oil, then roast about 1 hour until soft, cool, peel, purée and season.

steps.title: Caramelise
steps.text: Heat the other 45 ml oil until hot, add the 3 sliced red onions and toss, then cook over medium about 25 min until soft and browned and season.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Stir together the 455 g ricotta, 2 tbsp rosemary, 2 eggs, half the 150 g parmesan and a little salt and pepper.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Melt the 45 g butter, stir in the 55 g flour and cook 2 min, add the 830 ml milk and stir until it boils and thickens, then fold through the rest of the parmesan, ¼ tsp nutmeg and the 450 g spinach and season.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Turn the oven down to 175 °C and grease the dish, then spread about 240 ml spinach sauce over the base.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Add pasta, half the squash, pasta, all the ricotta topped with the onions, pasta, the rest of the squash, pasta and finally the remaining spinach sauce.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with foil and bake 1 hour, then uncover and bake 15 min more.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave to settle 15 min before cutting into portions.

tips: Roast the squash until it collapses easily so the purée is smooth and silky.
Cook the onions slowly and patiently for the deepest, sweetest colour.
Squeeze the defrosted spinach thoroughly dry to keep the sauce thick.
storage: Chill leftovers and keep for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
